hero.subtext: waiTime automatically fills cancelled appointments by instantly notifying patients on your waitlist — zero staff involvement, zero missed revenue.

problem.title: The hidden cost of cancellations
problem.subtitle: Empty slots aren't just an inconvenience — they represent direct revenue loss and delayed care for patients who need it.
problem.stat1Desc: Studies at Swiss outpatient clinics report missed appointment rates between 11.4% and 15.8% — every one is a lost slot.
problem.stat2Desc: Each unfilled cancellation represents direct revenue that disappears unless the slot is actively recovered.
problem.stat3Desc: While slots go empty, patients on waitlists wait months for appointments that could have been theirs.

howItWorks.title: Fully automated slot filling
howItWorks.subtitle: waiTime acts as your invisible assistant, monitoring your schedule and acting the moment an opening appears.
howItWorks.step1Desc: When a patient cancels in your EHR system, waiTime is immediately notified via a secure webhook — no manual action needed.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The matching engine filters your waitlist by each patient's stated preferences — date range, time of day, day of week — and ranks eligible patients.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Matching patients receive an SMS or email: "Slot available April 15 at 10:30am — reply YES to book." First to confirm gets the appointment. No app required.

ehrs.title: Built for Swiss outpatient workflows
ehrs.subtitle: waiTime connects to your existing EHR system via a secure, event-driven notification. No data is ever stored on our servers — your patient records stay exactly where they are.
ehrs.compatible: Compatible with leading Swiss EHR systems
ehrs.note: Patient data never leaves your EHR environment. waiTime receives only the minimum event data needed to trigger a match, processes it in memory, and discards it immediately.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Plans scale with the size of your practice.
